No source gave numbered local coach routes (e.g. Latifabad No. 7/8) with ordered stops. The only named private corridors are the 7 from the 2025 MUET paper, endpoints only. Its corridor 01 (Haider Chowk - Ayubia restaurant, 'Red Buses/Pink bus') is the Peoples Bus, so it is left out. OSM has about 60 named bus_stop nodes in Hyderabad (e.g. 'Latifabad Unit No 7', '10 Number Bus Stop', 'Ponay 7 Bus Stop', Paretabad, Hala Naka) but no private route relations; they could help geocode stops later. Gaps: numbered coach routes, chingchi routes, fares.

systems.notes: Only source with route IDs: the 2017 MUET paper (Table 1). It lists 8 stage-carriage routes gazetted June 2006. Four were operational in 2017 and are included above. The four listed as NON-OPERATIONAL in 2017 are left out of routes: B3 Aziz Cross (Pindi Bye-pass) - WAPDA Town; B6 Behari Colony - Rahwali Cantt; B7 Zamindara Stand - Dharam Kot Chowk; B8 Tatley Aali - Aziz Cross. Same paper: Qingqis have 'no specified routes'. About 16,000 passengers/day use Qingqis/rickshaws illegally along GT Road between Chanda Qilla and Pindi Bypass, with most boarding between Sheikhupura Morr and Gondlanwala. Urban Unit 2021 Connectivity Plan (83 pp, text extracted): has no intra-city route table. Its data-request annex only lists items it asked the Secretary DRTA for (intra-city route map, route permits by mode, bus stops, Qingqi route details); none of these are published in the plan. TPU Gujranwala study page: summary only, no routes and no PDF. Transport Dept bus-terminal PDFs (transport.punjab.gov.pk/system/files/Gujranwala.pdf and 'Gujranwala Bus Stand_0.pdf') returned 403. punjabtransport.org route-notification page refused connection. MUET article HTML/PDF blocks WebFetch (403) but opens with a browser user agent. OSM Overpass: no bus/minibus/share_taxi route relations in the Gujranwala bbox. English/Urdu searches found no numbered wagon/Hiace/Qingqi route lists or stop sequences (Dawn 2004 archive, Dunya city pages, Nawa-i-Waqt, Graana, UrduPoint). Excluded: Gujranwala Mass Transit/metro feeder (government), UMT university shuttle.

OSM only has B-10 (14168850), not duplicated. Gaps: current (2020s) FUTS route numbering and ordered stops; Qingqi routes (WEDC says no fixed routes).

open_questions: Multan: no private intracity route with named endpoints found. No verifiable private intracity route (wagon/Hiace/minibus/Qingqi/Suzuki) with a number or stops found. Searched: English+Urdu queries (ملتان ویگن روٹ نمبر, route-number/fare/RTA-permit queries, Dera Adda/Chowk Kumharan/Hussain Agahi/BZU/Qasim Pur/Shujabad Road wagon, Qingqi routes), Dawn/Tribune/Dunya/Nawa-i-Waqt, wikiroutes (no Multan page), safar.fyi (only Metro, MFR feeders, Green e-bus), OSM Overpass (only Metro relation 10995086), PMA 'Multan - Public Transport Routes' PDF (government planned feeder network - excluded), Urban Unit Multan Transport & Connectivity plan (regional roads, no paratransit routes), ReCAP 2020 Qingqi report (rural districts), Lok Sujag 2023 women-transport story (no route details), travelmultan blogspot. Papers note Multan transport is mostly unofficial three-wheelers without published routes. Gap: needs field survey or a local Facebook/community source.

Sialkot: no private intracity route with named endpoints found. No intracity wagon/Hiace/Qingqi/pickup route with named stops was found. TPU (site visit 25-07-2012): qingqis, auto-rickshaws, pick-ups and wagons ply 'without any proper routes'. TPU reviewed four proposed bus routes (SCCI/DRTA) but published no endpoints. Graana Lari Adda Sialkot blog (Nov 2024) covers intercity services only. Urban Unit PCIIP city-profile URLs for Sialkot and Gujranwala return 404. OSM Overpass: no route relations in the Sialkot bbox. Sialkot-Daska and Sialkot-Sambrial searches returned only the government electric bus (excluded), trains and intercity operators; no local wagon route data. Excluded: UMT Sialkot free student shuttle (admin.umt.edu.pk PDF), which is a university service, not public transport.

Quetta: no private intracity route with named endpoints found. Searched in English and Urdu (local bus route numbers, Sariab Road, Satellite Town, Kuchlak, Hazara Town, Brewery Road, Airport Road, bus association, RTA permits, fares, strikes). Sources tried: Arab News, Dawn, Tribune (403), Jang, Daily Qudrat, Balochistan Point (TLS error), Wikivoyage, ResearchGate (403), PIDE thesis compilation, JICA/ADB and OSM. No source names any of the private local bus routes. Route counts conflict: 7 routes (Arab News, Mar 2023) vs 15 routes (Arab News, Jul 2023), both with about 550 buses. A GPP Balochistan 'Study on intra-city bus transport system in Quetta' was tendered in Nov 2021 (globalmasstransit.net EOI notice), but no published output was found. That study, RTA Quetta route permits or the All Mutahida Bus Association are the best leads. OSM has a few stop nodes (Wahdat Colony Stops 1-3, Brewery Last Stop, Joint Road, 'Local Bus Stop', Sadabahar terminal, Jabal-e-Noor New Bus Station) but no route relations.

Sukkur: no private intracity route with named endpoints found. Searched in English, Urdu and Sindhi for Sukkur wagon/Suzuki/minibus/chingchi routes (Military Road, Barrage Road, Old Sukkur, Minara Road, Rohri), Suzuki stands, RTA, news and theses. Nothing names an intracity private route, even by endpoints. Sources only say that Suzuki pickups/vans run fixed main-road routes and that Qingqi rickshaws work as shared taxis. Other results were the Peoples Bus (out of scope) and the Sukkur-Shikarpur government bus (intercity). OSM has only terminal nodes (Sukkur Bus Station, Blue Lines, KCS, Daewoo) and no route relations. Gap: needs a field survey or a local Facebook/Kawish/Awami Awaz source.

Abbottabad: no private intracity route with named endpoints found. Searched (EN/UR): Suzuki routes for Mandian, Supply, Jhangi, Nawanshehr, Kakul, PMA, Havelian, Salhad, Dhamtour; RTA route-permit and fare notifications; COMSATS/academic papers; Dawn/The News/Nation/APP/Hazara Express News; OSM Overpass (no route relations in the Abbottabad bbox). No readable source gives a named or numbered list of private Suzuki routes. Recent context: in July 2026 the Commissioner Hazara introduced route-specific colour-coded stickers for Suzukis (APP/ProPakistani, 2026-07-07); neither article lists the route-to-colour mapping, and the RTA holds the sticker records. A Pink (women/families) and Blue (men) Suzuki service was being enforced by traffic police from about 2026-09-01 (Hazara Express News), with no routes listed. Facebook, Instagram and TikTok posts on these (e.g. facebook.com/YouthofAbbottabad, instagram.com/p/DcQ6Uuztak5) had no route details. The Express Tribune story 2448765 (Suzuki fares to Ayub Medical Complex and Nawan Shehr) was blocked (403). Best lead: RTA Abbottabad's colour-sticker route list, which may be posted on the DC Abbottabad or Traffic Police Facebook pages.

Mardan: no private intracity route with named endpoints found. Searched (EN/UR): wagon, Suzuki and Qingqi routes for Par Hoti, Sheikh Maltoon Town, Bagh-e-Aram, Toru, Takht Bhai Road and Charsadda Road; Mardan RTA/TMA stands; Dawn/The News/Tribune; OSM Overpass (no route relations in the Mardan bbox). No readable source lists named private intracity routes. Unverified context from search snippets only (not read): Mardan reportedly had 8 category-D stands plus a general stand, ordered to move to the new Chamtar terminal (Nation 2024-01-17; Dawn news/1811064), and The News reports Qingqis have no designated parking in the city. The Express Tribune 'Pink bus service starts in Mardan' (story 1943904) was blocked (403). Best leads: TMA Mardan or RTA Mardan Qingqi and Suzuki route registrations, and the local Facebook pages of Sheikh Maltoon Town and Super Hoti transport.
City id 'mardan' is not in data/cities.json (a bbox of roughly [34.12,71.95,34.28,72.15] would be needed); only the mardan-pink-bus system uses it.
